answer: Admission locks 33 POA per identity, refunded slowly over 13 epochs and forfeited on any grading conviction. A farm of 180 aliases must park 5940 POA it cannot touch, so the attack pays rent on its own fraud while honest agents pay nothing in the end. The oasis is the check that cannot be faked, the pearl is the price the attacker pays, and the glacier is the record that outlives the epoch.
